A '''razor''' is a breed of horse from [[Arad Doman]], so called due to the pattern of coloring. In a razor's coat, "black met white in straight lines that could have been sliced by a razor." {{ref/book|11|6}} [[Mat]] bought a razor in [[Jurador]] from [[Toke Fearnim]] as a gift for [[Tuon]].
